text:
alex_sales: Mariner Data (new reseller) says the reseller discount wasn't applied to Feb usage. They want a retroactive credit and Net60.

tom_bridge: How big is the delta?

alex_sales: They say $18,200 missing (25% discount on $72,800). They used partner key but missed the partner onboarding toggle.

mira_finance: Our policy: up to $10k discretionary credits. Above needs CFO sign-off. Net60 requests need AR approval.

sylvia_legal: If onboarding UX caused the miss, we should own part of it. But retrospectives set precedent. Recommend compromise.

alex_sales: Partner threatens to pause deployments unless we handle this quickly.

tom_bridge: Partner is strategic, potential ARR ~900k. I'd support a one-time make-good to preserve the relationship.

mira_finance: Proposal: approve $12k credit now, convert remaining $6.2k into a partner voucher applied to future invoices, and require partner to complete onboarding steps. Also deny Net60; offer Net30 with a one-time Net45 for the first invoice.

sylvia_legal: I'll draft a reseller addendum and exception memo. Record this in deal-exceptions ledger.

billing-bot: Draft credit memo CM-MAR-2026-02 created for $12,000. Will apply once addendum uploaded.

alex_sales: Partner accepted the compromise verbally. I'll get signature today.

billing-bot: Applied $12,000 credit and created voucher for $6,200. Invoice updated. :white_check_mark:

mira_finance: Approving and closing thread. Please note remediation: product to fix onboarding toggle; revops to add partner discount health check
